profile_text.body:
The Alignment Research Center, which goes by ARC, is a nonprofit research organization founded in 2021 and based in Berkeley, California. Its site states that its mission is to align future machine learning systems with human interests. ARC describes itself as expecting that new techniques will be needed to align AI systems as they surpass human capabilities, and it argues that progress in AI may outpace the ability to adapt, so methods that can be safely scaled across many orders of magnitude would leave the field better prepared, in the way generative pretraining and reinforcement learning have been scaled up over the past decade.

The material available on ARC is limited to that mission and motivation. No products are tracked for the company, no MCP servers are listed, and no lawsuits are recorded. Its law exposure is listed under California, with a count of 237.
